text:
Alex: Proposal: add a "soft_sample" fallback for early rollouts. Not full degrade; sends a tiny fraction to fallback variant + records deterministic sample tags. Low risk. Thoughts?
Priya: Nice. Need clear triggers: sustained error_rate > 3% for 2m, or p95 latency > 1s for 1m. Also want a quality drift trigger (eval delta > 2%).
Omar: Important: make sampling deterministic per request so replays and offline diffs are repeatable. Suggest: sample_key = hash(seed + session_id || prompt_hash) < sampling_threshold.
Lin: UX: in the rollout timeline show a compact "soft sample" pill. Clicking opens a panel with sampled count, sample rate, top divergence metric, and a Replay button.
Alex: API draft (inline): ```json
{
  "fallback_policy": "soft_sample",
  "triggers": [
    {"metric":"error_rate","op":">","value":0.03,"window_sec":120},
    {"metric":"latency_p95_ms","op":">","value":1000,"window_sec":60}
  ],
  "sample_fraction": 0.01,
  "sample_seed": "customer:rollout:2026-03-23",
  "billing_attribution": "target",
  "audit_retention_days": 90
}
```
Priya: Two questions: 1) billing—bill as target or original? 2) audit retention policy. Ops will care about costs + compliance.
Omar: Recommend billing_attribution configurable. Default to "target" to reflect actual compute. Add an opt-in to bill_as_original for cost-accounting compatibility.
Lin: UI actions: "Pause sampling", "Snooze (1h)", "Promote to hard fallback", and "Open sampled viewer". All actions create audit events and require operator confirmation + reason.
Alex: Telemetry schema changes: add fields fallback_mode (none|soft_sample|hard), sample_seed, sample_decision (true|false), decision_trace_id. Make them optional to avoid breaking old logs.
Priya: Alerting: when sampled responses diverge on eval metrics by > X% over N samples, fire a grouped alert to SRE+owner and surface in rollout timeline. Use stable reason codes (e.g., FBL_QUAL_DRIFT).
Omar: For deterministic sampling we should include a "sample_key" derivation. If session_id absent, fall back to user_ip salt, then request_ts. Document precisely so SDKs can replicate.
Lin: Replay feature: run the exact sampled request against both variants in a sandbox; show side-by-side token diffs, latency, and a tiny provenance header (model_id, model_version, flags). No PII.
Alex: Security/compliance: audit logs immutable, require at least two admins to delete. Keep prompt/response hashes (sha256) not plain text. Store raw artifacts only if customer opts in and signs an agreement.
Priya: QA: add unit tests for deterministic sampling (seed edgecases), and an integration test that exercises soft_sample -> promote -> rollback path.
Omar: Implementation note: keep sampling decision cheap and local to the proxy plane to avoid extra RPCs. Propagate decision_trace_id downstream for telemetry.
Lin: Small UX nuance: show the sample fraction as both absolute (0.01) and estimated RPS. Also a note if the sampled variant is using slower hardware.
Alex: I'll open RFC PR with API + telemetry + UI checklist. Assigning @Lin for mockups, @Omar for sampling algorithm PR, @Priya for alert rules + QA plan.
